scope_description.detailed_scope_narrative: Comprehensive migration of legacy on-premise compute and data workloads to sovereign multi-region cloud infrastructure.
scope_description.major_outcomes: Zero-downtime database replication cutover, container orchestration platform rollout, and legacy hardware decommissioning.

acceptance_criteria.criteria: CIS Benchmark Level 2 compliance verification and Infosec sign-off.
Data consistency check 100% matched across source and target schemas within 4-hour cutover window.

out_of_scope_items: Refactoring of end-of-life legacy third-party desktop utilities
project_exclusions.operational_boundaries: Migration scope terminates at OS and platform tier; application maintenance remains with business unit teams.
